report.summary: 根据所提供的代码包，把父页面条件改成 quote && delivery 后，此时还没有 current assessment，面板（Panel）和视图（view）的安全性可以确认：sourceVisibilityView 在 delivery?.assessment 缺失时返回 plan: undefined（store 第18行）；组件第13行的 effect 只按路径和身份标识拉取，不调用模型；历史报告由第42行按 stale 标签展示；运行按钮被第16行（!delivery?.assessment）和第36行（!plan）双重禁用，saveSourceVisibility 在服务端会拒绝不符合当前交付和评估的输入。Panel 自己不会把旧观察误标为当前。没有发现可报告的具体缺陷。需要说明的是，所提供的 source packet 没有包含创建报告的 source-visibility.ts 与 createSourceVisibilityReport，因此无法独立验证它确实按 deliveryId 加 assessmentId 记录 stale；也没有包含父页面文件，因此无法确认修改后的挂载条件能否通过类型检查。
limitations: The source packet does not include the parent page, so I cannot verify that quote && delivery removes the TypeScript narrowing problem that the original quote && delivery?.assessment condition caused in the JSX, or that delivery is non-null wherever the panel uses it.

Review is limited to SourceVisibilityPanel.tsx, lib/source-visibility-store.ts and the skill text. The createSourceVisibilityReport / validateStoredVisibilityReport logic in lib/source-visibility.ts, the client implementation of runSourceVisibility in lib/source-visibility-probe, and the API route that builds the ProofRecord were not supplied. I therefore cannot verify from source that a new report is bound to the current deliveryId, deliveryDigest and assessmentId, or how the server computes stale.

Line 42 only uses report.stale, which server line 20 computes as !plan || report.deliveryId!==plan.deliveryId || report.deliveryDigest!==plan.deliveryDigest || report.assessmentId!==plan.assessmentId. The correctness of marking old reports stale depends on that code, which was not provided.

Line 39 says the plan requires the current delivery's AI assessment; I read this as consistent with the goal of showing old reports without a new model call, but the UI wording is not a correctness proof.
No code was executed. No typecheck, build, browser interaction, API call or model call was run or observed; all conclusions come only from reading the supplied lines.

The packet does not show where history is fetched from the server (the API route is absent). I assumed that GET path returns sourceVisibilityView directly and that history is scoped by quote_id (store line 15). I could not verify that the GET route does not call a model.

Historical report rows appear under an open <details> for index 0 (line 42), using a generic 'Historical delivery/assessment observation' label and showing deliveryId / assessmentId (line 46). I cannot confirm from the packet that this label is clear enough to prevent users confusing old observations with the current state. This is a UX judgment, not a confirmed defect.
